 Why Vaibhav Suryavanshi is Not Playing 
 Why Vaibhav Suryavanshi is Not Playing in Delhi vs Bihar SMAT 2026 Match? Revealed
 Sportsdunia Desk Published -  Nov 18, 2026, 02:20 AM 3 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Vaibhav Suryavanshi Vaibhav Suryavanshi is not part of Bihar's playing 11 for their Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026-27 clash against Delhi on Wednesday, November 18. The match takes place at the Daly College Ground in Indore, with the action scheduled to begin at 9:00 AM IST.
 Bihar head into the contest after securing a four-wicket win over Railways, while Delhi are also coming off a huge 109-run win against Punjab. However, fans will once again miss the opportunity to watch Vaibhav Suryavanshi in SMAT in action.
 Why is Vaibhav Suryavanshi Not Playing Today in SMAT 2026 Match?
 One of the most dangerous batsmen in the world , Vaibhav Suryavanshi is unavailable for Bihar's clash against Delhi because he has joined the India A camp for the upcoming ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. The tournament begins on November 19 in Doha, Qatar, and the youngster is part of the 15-member India A squad led by Tilak Varma .
 India A begin their campaign against Nepal on November 20 at the West End Park International Stadium in Doha. They are placed in Group B alongside Nepal, Pakistan A and the UAE. The team also faces Pakistan A on November 22 before taking on the UAE on November 24.
 Suryavanshi's absence from the Delhi fixture is therefore linked to his international assignment. He also missed Bihar's second SMAT match against Railways for the same reason, having linked up with the India A squad ahead of the tournament. Suraj Kashyap takes over the captaincy in his absence, guiding Bihar to a four-wicket win over Railways.

 Vaibhav Suryavanshi Captained Bihar in SMAT 2026
 The young prodigy, Vaibhav Suryavanshi , made history by captaining Bihar in their opening fixture against Saurashtra, becoming the youngest player to lead a team in men's T20 cricket at 15 years and 232 days. He takes over the leadership responsibilities for the first two matches in the absence of regular captain Sakibul Gani.
 However, his captaincy debut does not go as planned with the bat. The left-handed opener scores 18 runs off 12 deliveries, hitting two fours and a six before Chetan Sakariya dismisses him. Bihar post 137/9, but Saurashtra chase down the target to win by five wickets. Suryavanshi does not feature in the subsequent fixture against Railways, as his India A commitments take priority. His brief stint as Bihar captain thus ends after just one appearance.
